name: WF-100 — Telegram local intake (INATIVO ATE CUTOVER)

parameters.query:
WITH authorized AS (
  SELECT 1 FROM channel_adapters
  WHERE adapter_id = 'telegram-local-poller'
    AND channel = 'TELEGRAM'
    AND status IN ('SHADOW', 'ACTIVE')
    AND secret_hash = $9
), attempted_update AS (
  INSERT INTO channel_updates (channel, external_update_id, tenant_id, owner_id, chat_id, message_id, sender_is_bot, payload, payload_hash, status)
  SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NULLIF($6, ''), $7::boolean, $8::jsonb, $10, CASE WHEN $7::boolean THEN 'IGNORED' ELSE 'QUEUED' END
  FROM authorized
  ON CONFLICT (channel, external_update_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING channel, external_update_id
), inbound AS (
  INSERT INTO channel_inbound_events (inbound_event_id, channel, external_update_id, tenant_id, owner_id, chat_id, event_kind, text_content)
  SELECT md5($1 || '|' || $2)::uuid, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $11, $12
  FROM authorized
  WHERE NOT $7::boolean
  ON CONFLICT (channel, external_update_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING inbound_event_id
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authorized) AS accepted,
  (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted_update) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_updates WHERE channel = $1 AND external_update_id = $2)) AS persisted,
  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted_update) AS duplicate,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbound) AS queued,
  $2 AS update_id;
